extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective article creators / editors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating or locating a Wikipedia article (here for the title 'Box office 2024'), including account/status requirements, searching for existing content, handling recent creations/deletions, and title/redirect considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is presented as an option for users who cannot directly create new pages (e.g., not autoconfirmed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Box office 2024" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps avoid creating duplicate or differently titled pages; recommended before creating a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check what links to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' to discover existing coverage or incoming links that may indicate the topic is covered elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay/visibility for recently created pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to refresh and reveal newly created pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check capitalization variants and create redirects where appropriate to unify access to the topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult deletion history and guidance pages to understand reasons for removal and whether recreation is appropriate.
